messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Neon Pairs is built. Open the offline game at [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html).

The implementation includes board codes, snapshot export and import, saved preferences and best scores, and the replay CLI. The game core, browser session, board and controls are separated under `src/game` as specified.

Verification passed with the documented tool versions: `npm ci`, type checking, unit tests and the fresh-build browser suite. The browser checks include offline play with network requests blocked, a complete keyboard game, snapshot pause and resume, and 16×16 layouts. The replay command was also checked with valid and invalid input.

No screen reader was used; spoken-output confirmation remains for user acceptance.
